title: ggsegJHU 3.0.0
text: jhu() removed. 11-region unified atlas collapsed tracts merged hemispheres. jhu_tracts() covers anatomy full resolution (20 tracts, hemispheres separate) jhu_wm() carries 48-region ICBM-DTI-81 parcellation, jhu() ever offered coarser view data accessors already provide. jhu_tracts() now tract atlas (atlas_type() returns "tract", object tract_atlas) rather subcortical one. tract carries principal-curve centerline, drawn 3D tube ggseg3d() 2D projection anatomical silhouette. Code dispatched subcortical_atlas longer match . uncinate fasciculus temporal part superior longitudinal fasciculus swapped previous releases. FSL orders uncinate (volume indices 17, 18) temporal SLF (19, 20), metadata assumed reverse, tracts carried ’s name. Verified volumes: labels 17/18 sit MNI (±35, +7, −15), limen insulae, uncinate; 19/20 (±43, −47, +4), posterior temporal, SLF-temporal. analysis selected uncf sltf earlier release selected wrong tract.

title: ggsegJHU 3.0.0
text: Tracts now built JHU’s probabilistic maps rather distributed maxprob-thr25 volume. volume keeps single highest-probability tract voxel, tracts sharing corridor erode : left temporal SLF survived 76 voxels bundle spanning several centimetres, far little fit meaningful centerline. tract now thresholded 25% maximum merged, raising labelled volume roughly four-fold. Overlaps resolved tract’s probability relative peak rather raw value. JHU’s per-tract maxima range 43% 97%, raw comparison hands every shared corridor whichever tract reliably reconstructed rather whichever voxel belongs . Worst-case retention rises 17% 37% tract’s core, total labelled volume unchanged — assignment differs. 2D projections taken five fixed anatomical positions, specified RAS millimetres rather voxel indices stay correct reference volume changes: axial +30, +8 −14 mm, coronal −18 mm sagittal −30 mm, projected ±8-slice slab. Tracts projections slab; silhouette framing true slice, taken wherever slab holds cortex. view draws tracts substantially represented , rather every tract happens intersect slab, left panel cluttered tract repeated. Left right stay together, every tract drawn least one view. Tracts coloured per bundle, left right sharing hue, giving 10 distinguishable colours. Earlier releases coloured coarser group (projection/association/limbic/commissure), leaving four colours 20 tracts. FSL ships colour table atlas, palette chosen rather inherited.

title: ggsegJHU 3.0.0
text: jhu_wm() stays subcortical atlas — ICBM-DTI-81 labels white-matter parcels rather pathways — build broken repaired: right superior longitudinal fasciculus missing entirely, 47 regions eroded. labels projected protect_cortex = TRUE, shields cortex cerebral white matter overwritten. guard suits deep grey structures subcortical pipeline built around, exactly wrong : protected white-matter atlas tissue describes. projection now runs guard , 48 regions survive. Regions coloured per structure, left right sharing hue, 27 distinguishable colours. Previously 48 shared five group colours. FreeSurfer anatomy labels projected now correctly kept grey context rather promoted atlas. leaking core palette, atlas_regions() reported cortical parcels though JHU white-matter labels. sagittal views read properly. sagittal cut runs along cortical ribbon rather across , thin slabs used axial coronal caught ribbon happened sit -plane broke outline fragments; sagittal slabs now wider. silhouette single slice, widening alone fill — ggseg.extra now picks slice cortex content, moves mid-sagittal reference interhemispheric fissure (x=134 rather 128) cuts medial wall ribbon instead grazing . Region outlines smoothed, pieces 20 px² dropped, parcels read shapes rather rasterised voxel staircases. build script longer aborts current ggseg.extra: used project_volume_anatomical()’s removed output_file return field, plus deprecated views argument write_ctab().

title: ggsegJHU 2.1.0
text: icbm() removed. legacy variant ICBM-DTI-81 white matter atlas 2D geometry, undivided hemispheres, group column. Use jhu_wm() instead, covers anatomy 2D 3D geometry. jhu_labels() (introduced 2.0.0) now jhu_wm().

title: ggsegJHU 2.1.0
text: smoother region boundaries (trilinear resampling + argmax replaces voxel-grid jaggedness raw 1mm masks); true cortical-reference outline behind white-matter regions every 2D slice, anatomically aligned labels. Custom view ranges replace default subcortical views brainstem lateral structures clipped. core table now carries group column atlases.
